kind: REPORTED by the author: real useKast hook, real React 19.2.0 StrictMode, FAKE SDK, Chromium; no provider, network or microphone

results.name: STRICT MODE: double effects start exactly one SDK session; tools are bound to it
LATE CALLBACKS from finished attempt A cannot touch attempt B (message, mode, error, disconnect)
DISCONNECT BEFORE START RESOLVES: never connected; the late session is ended; tools dead
PROVIDER ERROR invalidates tools at once, while cleanup is still pending, then ends once
START REJECTED (mic denied): contained, retry blocked, reload required, no second SDK call
DELAYED cleanup blocks a replacement; it unblocks only after end() resolves
FAILED cleanup stays blocked and asks for a reload
UNMOUNT while connected: session ended once, tools dead, no late state updates
UNMOUNT while the start is pending: the late session is ended once and never reported connected
READ-ONLY keeps typed Q&A available while tools stay denied; saved context is never sent to the provider
